Tom Petty.blurb: American rock musician (1950–2017). “Love Is a Long Road” is from the 1989 album Full Moon Fever.

The Pointer Sisters.blurb: American vocal group formed in Oakland in 1969; “Hot Together” is a 1986 single.

Wang Chung.blurb: English new wave band; “Everybody Have Fun Tonight” was a 1986 hit from Mosaic.

Tammy Wynette.blurb: American country singer (1942–1998). “Talkin’ to Myself Again” is from her 1987 album Higher Ground.

Zenglen.blurb: Haitian kompa band. Trailer 2 uses “Child Support” (2004), often billed with 5 Etwal / 5 Etwel.

Jay Ferguson.blurb: American rock musician; “Thunder Island” was a 1977 solo hit.

Birdman.blurb: American rapper and Cash Money Records co-founder. “Pop Bottles” (with Lil Wayne) is from 2007.

Lil Wayne.blurb: American rapper; appears on Birdman’s 2007 single “Pop Bottles.”

Sexyy Red.blurb: American rapper from St. Louis. Rockstar named her in a 2026 Dazed interview; “Pound Town” is heard in the Extended Look.

Tay Keith.blurb: American record producer; credited on Sexyy Red’s “Pound Town.”

Kodak Black.blurb: American rapper. Tagged on Hendrix Smoke Instagram Story with Travis Scott Phase 1 GTA VI artwork (15 Sep 2026); own primary not yet attached.

The Bellamy Brothers.blurb: American country duo; “Let Your Love Flow” was a 1976 hit.

Def Leppard.blurb: English rock band; “Love Bites” is from the 1987 album Hysteria.

Depeche Mode.blurb: English electronic band; “People Are People” was released in 1984.

Captain & Tennille.blurb: American pop duo (Daryl Dragon and Toni Tennille). Polygon and IGN list “But I Think It’s a Dream” in the Extended Look.

Prefab Sprout.blurb: English pop band; “Cars and Girls” is from 1988’s From Langley Park to Memphis.

!!!.blurb: American dance-punk band (pronounced “chk chk chk”). “Off the Grid” features Meah Pace.

Meah Pace.blurb: Vocalist credited on !!!’s “Off the Grid,” listed in Polygon’s Extended Look IDs.

Cliff Richard.blurb: English singer. “Devil Woman” was a 1976 single. Music Ally notes it as a prominent Extended Look cue.

Chimbala.blurb: Dominican urban/dembow artist. Extended Look listings pair him with Omega on “Se Me Nota.”

Omega.blurb: Dominican merengue/urban singer (Omega El Fuerte), credited with Chimbala on “Se Me Nota.”

Phil Collins.blurb: English singer-songwriter; “Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now)” is from 1984.

Aluna.blurb: British singer-songwriter (Aluna Francis). Listed with Jayda G on “Mine O’ Mine” in the Extended Look.

Jayda G.blurb: Canadian DJ and producer; listed with Aluna on “Mine O’ Mine” in Extended Look IDs.

Elderbrook.blurb: English electronic musician; “Inner Light” is a collaboration with Bob Moses.

Bob Moses.blurb: Canadian electronic duo; listed with Elderbrook on “Inner Light” in the Extended Look.

Real Dimez.blurb: Fictional in-game duo described by Rockstar as rising stars whose story plays out on in-game social media. Not a real-world act.

Travis Scott.blurb: American rapper and producer. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “RHYNO” (prod. Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo), announced 17 Sep 2026.

Future.blurb: American rapper. Featured with Metro Boomin on Yung Lean’s Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “That’s It” (17 Sep 2026).

Morgan Wallen.blurb: American country singer. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Last Thing You Need,” announced 17 Sep 2026.

Keith Richards.blurb: English guitarist (The Rolling Stones). Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Bright Lights, Big City,” announced 17 Sep 2026.

CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso.blurb: Argentine duo. Credited on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Sexy Magic” with PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and Etienne de Crécy (17 Sep 2026).

Fred again...blurb: English producer/DJ. Credited on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Sexy Magic” with CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, and Etienne de Crécy (17 Sep 2026).

PinkPantheress.blurb: English singer-songwriter. Credited on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Sexy Magic” with CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, Fred again.., and Etienne de Crécy (17 Sep 2026).

Metro Boomin.blurb: American producer/rapper. Featured with Future on Yung Lean’s Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “That’s It” (17 Sep 2026).

Yung Lean.blurb: Swedish rapper. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “That’s It” (feat. Future & Metro Boomin), announced 17 Sep 2026.

Rauw Alejandro.blurb: Puerto Rican singer. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Macacoa 2000,” announced 17 Sep 2026.

Etienne de Crécy.blurb: French electronic producer. Credited on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “Sexy Magic” with CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, and Fred again.. (17 Sep 2026).

Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo.blurb: French musician (Daft Punk). Credited as producer on Travis Scott’s Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album debut single “RHYNO” (17 Sep 2026).

Rockstar Games.blurb: Publisher of Grand Theft Auto VI. Announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album with Atlantic Records on 17 Sep 2026.

Atlantic Records.blurb: Record label partnered with Rockstar Games on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album (34 original tracks; six debut singles, 17 Sep 2026).

Don Toliver.blurb: American rapper/singer. Tagged on Hendrix Smoke Instagram Story with Travis Scott Phase 1 GTA VI artwork (15 Sep 2026); own primary not yet attached.

Hendrix Smoke.blurb: Producer. Instagram Story (@hendrixsmoke) reshared Travis Scott Phase 1 artwork with “Let's Ride” and tagged Don Toliver, Kodak Black, ATL Jacob, RushDee (15 Sep 2026); durable story permalink unavailable.

ATL Jacob.blurb: American producer. Tagged on Hendrix Smoke Instagram Story with Travis Scott Phase 1 GTA VI artwork (15 Sep 2026); own primary not yet attached.

RushDee.blurb: Producer/engineer. Tagged on Hendrix Smoke Instagram Story with Travis Scott Phase 1 GTA VI artwork (15 Sep 2026); own primary not yet attached.

Zara Larsson.blurb: Swedish singer. "Midnight Sun (Girls Trip)" with PinkPantheress is a 2026 release named in Rockstar's Flash FM preview. It is not a GTA VI: The Album single.
